text: Given a mocked GET /api/v1/monitor/search response with 2 monitors, When datadog_search_monitors is called with no filter, Then the tool returns both monitors' summaries plus page/per_page/has_more
Given per_page requested above 100, When datadog_search_monitors is called, Then the service caps the upstream request at 100
Given a mocked 200 for a known monitor_id, When datadog_get_monitor is called, Then the full monitor detail is returned
Given a mocked 404 for an unknown monitor_id, When datadog_get_monitor is called, Then the tool returns the not_found error envelope, not an exception
Given a mocked 200 from POST .../mute, When datadog_mute_monitor is called with a scope and end time, Then the response confirms the muted state with that scope and end time
Given a muted monitor, When datadog_unmute_monitor is called, Then the response confirms the monitor is no longer muted
Given a mocked logs search response with matches, When datadog_search_logs is called with a query and time range, Then matching entries and a cursor (when more exist) are returned
Given a mocked logs search response with zero matches, When datadog_search_logs is called, Then the tool returns an empty result set, not a not_found error
Given a mocked GET /api/v1/query response with points, When datadog_query_metrics is called with a valid query string and time range, Then the timeseries points are returned
Given a mocked 400 for an invalid metric query string, When datadog_query_metrics is called, Then the tool returns the invalid_argument error envelope
Given a mocked GET /api/v1/metrics response with more names than the cap, When datadog_list_active_metrics is called, Then the response is truncated to the cap with has_more=true
Given a prefix filter, When datadog_list_active_metrics is called, Then only metric names starting with that prefix are returned
Given a mocked events search response with zero matches, When datadog_search_events is called, Then the tool returns an empty result set, not a not_found error
Given a request missing X-Datadog-Application-Key, When any tool is called, Then the service returns HTTP 401 listing the missing header name, and no request reaches the Datadog API

Given two concurrent requests carrying two different tenants' credentials, When both call a tool at the same time, Then each response's upstream call used only its own request's credentials, never the other tenant's
Given X-Datadog-Site: datadoghq.eu, When any tool is called, Then the outbound request targets https://api.datadoghq.eu, not the US1 default
Given no X-Datadog-Site header, When any tool is called, Then the outbound request targets https://api.datadoghq.com
Given a mocked 429 response followed by a 200, When a tool call hits the 429, Then the service retries with backoff and returns the eventual successful result
Given a mocked 503 on every retry attempt, When a tool call exhausts its retries, Then the service returns the upstream_error envelope with retryable: true

Given a real Datadog account's credentials, When each of the 8 tools is called via initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call against the live API, Then each returns a well-formed response matching its documented shape
steps: Obtain a real Datadog API key + Application key (any site)
Run the service locally with those headers set
Call initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call for each of the 8 tools with representative arguments
expect: Each tool call returns a well-formed JSON result matching the shape documented in Data & API contract; no tool returns a 500 or an unmapped exception
